name: Courts
_about: THE COURT: a ring of rooms round a courtyard as one part -- outer and courtyard walls, windows every `axis` metres, doors from the court into the rooms, floors on every storey, a stair up every storey, a gate through into the court, a roof on every side. The same part on a rectangle (a palace's quadrangle, Melk's Prälatenhof) and on a pentagon (Schwerin's).

quadrangle._about: a quadrangle of three storeys, its gate on the +z side
